English: A shallow copy shares references to nested mutable objects; a deep copy duplicates
සිංහල: Shallow copy එක nested objects share කරනවො. Deep copy එක ඒ mutable data වෙල
Original → shared nested list (shallow); separate list (deep for this model)
User shallow() { User u = new User(); u.tags = tags; return u; }
Interview question: Does copying a list always produce a deep copy?
Answer: No. Its elements may still be shared. This example works because String is immutable.
Remember: Original → shared nested list (shallow); separate list (deep for this model)
